queries.sql: select id::text,version,audience from community.communities where tenant_id=$1 and workspace_id=$2 and id=$3 for update
select id::text,community_id::text,version,audience,status,body from community.announcements where tenant_id=$1 and workspace_id=$2 and community_id=$3 and id=$4 for update
select app_private.ce_community_audience_valid_v1($1::jsonb,$2::uuid,$3::uuid) as valid

insert into community.announcements(id,tenant_id,workspace_id,community_id,body,audience,status,version,created_by)
 values($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6::jsonb,'draft',1,$7) returning id

update community.announcements set status=$5,version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 where tenant_id=$1 and workspace_id=$2 and community_id=$3 and id=$4 and version=$6
 and (($5='published' and status='draft') or ($5='cancelled' and status<>'cancelled')) returning id

select auth.uid()=$1::uuid as actor_bound,
  app_private.check_workspace_native_permission_v2_at_v1($2::uuid,$3::uuid,$4,$5,clock_timestamp()) as allowed,
  app_private.check_workspace_native_permission_v2_at_v1($2::uuid,$3::uuid,'community.community.read','community_basic',clock_timestamp()) as can_read,
  app_private.require_request_session_current_at_v1(clock_timestamp()) as session_guard

select r.tenant_id::text,r.membership_id::text,
 (auth.uid()=$3::uuid and auth.jwt()->>'session_id'=$4 and auth.jwt()->>'exp'=$5
  and auth.jwt()->>'role'='authenticated' and auth.jwt()->>'aal'='aal2') as actor_bound,
 app_private.check_workspace_native_permission_v2_at_v1($1,$2,'community.community.read','community_basic',clock_timestamp()) as can_read,
 app_private.check_workspace_native_permission_v2_at_v1($1,$2,'community.announcement.publish','community_basic',clock_timestamp()) as can_publish,
 (select revision::text from app_private.canonical_authority_revision_v1 where singleton) as revision,
 app_private.require_request_session_current_at_v1(clock_timestamp()) as session_guard
 from app_private.resolve_workspace_native_context_v2_at_v1($1,$2,clock_timestamp()) r
select customer_api.read_ce_community_v1($1::uuid,$2::uuid) as projection
begin isolation level serializable
select revision::text from app_private.canonical_authority_revision_v1 where singleton for share
rollback

select expires_at>clock_timestamp() as unexpired
              from platform.idempotency_keys where tenant_id=$1 and key=$2
set local search_path = pg_catalog
set local lock_timeout = '5s'
set local statement_timeout = '10s'
select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1,0))

select tenant_id from platform.customer_workspaces
              where id=$1 and archived_at is null and lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' for update
select txid_current()::text as id, clock_timestamp()::text as now

select auth.uid()=$1::uuid as actor_bound,
              app_private.check_workspace_native_permission_v2($2,$3,$4,$5) as allowed

select actor_id,request_hash,response_ref,expires_at from platform.idempotency_keys
              where tenant_id=$1 and key=$2 for update
select clock_timestamp()::text as now

insert into platform.idempotency_keys
            (tenant_id,actor_id,key,request_hash,expires_at) values($1,$2,$3,$4,statement_timestamp()+interval '1 day')

insert into audit.events
            (tenant_id,actor_id,action,entity_type,entity_id,request_id,after_snapshot)
            values($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7::jsonb) returning id::text

insert into platform.outbox_events
            (tenant_id,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,aggregate_version,event_type,payload,trace_id)
            values($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6::jsonb,$7) returning id::text

update platform.idempotency_keys set response_ref=$3::jsonb,status_code=200
            where tenant_id=$1 and key=$2
commit

select txid_current()::text as transaction_id,
        auth.uid()::text as actor_id, current_setting('transaction_isolation') as isolation,
        clock_timestamp()::text as evaluated_at

select revision::text
      from app_private.canonical_authority_revision_v1 where singleton for share

select m.tenant_id::text, m.user_id::text as actor_id,
        m.status::text, (m.starts_at<=clock_timestamp()
          and (m.ends_at is null or m.ends_at>clock_timestamp())
          and g.starts_at<=clock_timestamp()
          and (g.ends_at is null or g.ends_at>clock_timestamp())) as current
      from identity.context_grants g join identity.memberships m
        on m.id=g.membership_id and m.tenant_id=g.tenant_id
      where g.id=$1

select tenant_id::text
      from platform.customer_workspaces where id=$1 and archived_at is null
        and lifecycle_status='ACTIVE'

select
      app_private.check_workspace_native_permission_v2($1,$2,$3,$4) as allowed,
      statement_timestamp()::text as evaluated_at, d.id::text as module_definition_id,
      d.entitlement_key from platform.module_definitions d
      where d.code=$4 and d.is_active and d.lifecycle_status in ('active','published')
        and d.valid_from<=statement_timestamp()
        and (d.valid_to is null or d.valid_to>statement_timestamp())
